name: Touch Controls
summary: On-screen sticks and buttons for a phone, driving the same actions a gamepad would.
description: Draws thumb sticks and action buttons over the game and pushes them through the player's virtual input layer, so a controller written for a keyboard needs no changes. Sticks can be fixed or float to where the thumb lands, and a mouse simulator lets the whole thing be tried in the editor, which has no touch panel.
nextSteps: Add a TouchOverlay component to any actor; it builds its own canvas.
Set Buttons to the actions you want on screen, such as Jump and Attack.
Turn on SimulateWithMouse to try it in the editor, which has no touch panel.
